QuestInfo.name: [Chicken Smackaroo] Lazy Mama Chicken's Wake-Up Call

QuestInfo.1:
Hunt monsters around your level until #bTKTKTK#k and collect some #i3994873##b#t3994873##k items.

Get 37 #b#t3994873##k items to get the #i5680205##b#t5680205##k where the baby chick sleeps in.

#r(You can only get Lovely Warmth from monsters 11 or more levels lower than you, or 21 or more levels higher than you.)#k
